_comment: A review of an open MR, produced somewhere else and posted here. Step 5 of the demo imports this. Swap it for real output from your own harness — the shape is documented in the README under 'Uploading a review run elsewhere'.
title: PAY-1204 tidy up the payout handler

findings.message: `.expect()` panics when the account is missing, taking the process down on a normal error path.
This line is longer than the surrounding code and should be split for readability.

verdicts.note: Right. A deleted account is a routine 404 in this service, not an invariant — panicking here kills the payout worker for the whole batch.
Wrong, and off-topic: this skill reviews error handling, not formatting. The real problem on that line is the discarded Result, which it did not mention.
